prompt: Trong không gian <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, cho mặt phẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>P</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> cắt các trục <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></semantics></math> lần lượt tại <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có phương trình dạnh <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>. Tính <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></semantics></math>.
solution:
Phương trình mặt phẳng (P) là
x2+y1+z−2=1⇔x+2y−z−2=0.
Suy ra a=1, b=2, c=−1. Do đó a+b+c=1+2+(−1)=2.
